# P1.07 — Findings surface, full: Margin, triage mode, Apply

Spec: `docs/tickets/35_P1.07__findings-surface-full.md` · run ledger: `docs/build/runs/P1.07.md`
**Stage A only** — all code + deterministic tests. Stage B (deploy `api` + `web` to `dev`, bounded
live verify on already-delivered dossiers, $0) is operator-gated → **D-P1.07-1**.

## Summary

The findings surface in its full §5.7 form: **one `Finding[]`** powers the Margin (cards beside
passages, stacked chips for crowds), the Desk findings table (the screen-reader landmark + triage
queue), and the Approve-triage card — with linked selection, shared filters, triage mode, the free
**Apply** verb (REQ-SPEC-6), one-preview bulk actions (REQ-IDE-29 amended), and the obligation/
evidence/reconciliation surface behaviors. All derivation lives in `@rhema/findings-core`
(`surface.ts` + `apply.ts`); React renders, web/api do I/O — the ticket's "move it out of the
component" rule is held throughout.

## What landed

**`@rhema/findings-core`** — `surface.ts`: `marginItems` (card|chip, unanchored → *Whole piece*
first, per-paragraph stacking, 30-finding cluster threshold), `FindingFilters` +
`parseFindingFilters`/`filterFindings` (severity/kind/origin/disposition/section/has-URL/
has-suggestion/open-obligation — one filter state narrows all surfaces), `sectionedTriageQueue`
(section groups, blocking→major→minor→note, decided/total + open-obligation counts),
`severityBudget`/`applySeverityBudget` (Quick's honest 40-finding cap), `applyGate`, `bulkSelect`.
`apply.ts`: `applySuggestionToMarkdown` (anchor ladder; refuses rather than guesses),
`buildBulkPreview` (scratch-copy combined diff).

**`@rhema/ui`** — NEW `margin.tsx` (MarginSurface + MarginTicks + expandable stacked chips) and
`findings-desk.tsx` (FindingsDesk: real `<table>` landmark, shared filter bar, triage queue +
progress pill, bulk controls, disposition/action cells gated by `canDispose`). `findings.tsx` and
`ide-shell.tsx` gain the triage/bulk/status slots and the `marginBody`/`deskFindingsBody` mounts
(fallbacks preserved). Letter sections carry `findingRefs` → passage links resolve to finding
anchors.

**`@rhema/editor` + `@rhema/tokens`** — decorations carry kind/suggestion/finding-id/anchor-method
metadata; severity-weight underlines (blocking 2px solid · major 1.5px · minor dotted · note
faint) × kind hues (claim amber · discourse violet · argument blue · craft teal · voice/continuity
rose), chip/triage/selected/lost styles — all contrast-suite covered.

**`apps/api`** — `finding-routes.ts`: Apply (`POST …/findings/:fid/apply` — splice into the
working head via `saveManualRevision` + `suggestion_applied` provenance, frozen heads fork
`v(N+1) human_revision`, records `accept·applied·by:user·moveId:human`, lock/409 aware), promote
(REQ-IDE-26), Add-to-obligations (REQ-OBJ-9), free-form obligation create (REQ-OBJ-10,
`source:'user'`), the `/resolve` deep link, and the bulk preview + dispatch pair (`only[]` = the
preview's checked subset — no blind accept-all). The editor's findings rail now carries
kind/suggestion for the decoration layer.

**`apps/web`** — the dossier renders the three surfaces from `visibleDossierFindings` (budget →
filters → groups once); `?triage=1`, `?bulk=<action>` preview page, `?bulkdone`/`applied`/
`promoted`/`obligated`/`ferr` notices; finding write POSTs + `/p/:slug/f/:fid` deep link + the
`/p/:slug/obligations/new` form (the palette's "New obligation…" Go-to row lands here); the
`ide.ts` island binds the §5.12 findings chords — `J/K`, `P`, `A D R F E`, `Enter`, `Esc`,
`⌥J/⌥K` — active only with Margin/Findings focus, inert in the Page; linked selection syncs card,
row, and span; the View-menu suggestions toggle renders read-only preview text (never document
bytes). Compact renders keep the §10.1 phone contract (five verbs + note, no bulk).
